name: EPIC 210701812
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 9.1 solar radii and 1.04 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210701812 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.131737 (16th-84th percentiles 8.72395-9.546228), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210701812 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM mass (solar masses) 1.036858 (16th-84th percentiles 0.926483-1.152458), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210701812: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4800.5645 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210701812 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 2968.359375 (16th-84th percentiles 2863.164062-3071.796875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.35 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the color routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 2,968 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.04 solar masses and 9.1 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,801 K at its surface.
